stable.notes: Reverts the 0.5.131 motion for still characters. Sliding and rotating a whole static figure read as a sticker being wiggled rather than a character moving, so the three bundled Jedi go back to standing still until they have real sprite frames. Everything from 0.5.130 stays: switching characters replaces the whole character instead of layering, legacy packs draw every state, idle session rows can be dropped from the pet list after ten minutes, and double-clicking the character opens the active-session list. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
